visual_elements.description: Feed-forward neural-network schematic, 3 rows (top/middle/bottom) x 5 columns of neuron circles inside the beige panel. Col 1: three gray circles, each split by a vertical line into 'Σ' (left) and 'S' (right); each is followed by three small hollow circles 'o o o'; four magenta dots stacked vertically at the far left (outside/edge of panel) feed thin gray lines into these three neurons. Col 2: three light-blue Σ|S neurons, each labeled 'O_i' (red italic) at its upper right. Col 3: three light-green Σ|S neurons labeled 'O_j'. Col 4: three light-orange Σ|S neurons labeled 'O_k'. Col 5: three gray Σ|S neurons, each preceded by two small hollow circles 'o o', each followed by a short black arrow to a black output box. Thin red lines fully mesh col2→col3, col3→col4, and col2→col4 (skip connections). Above the columns, red italic 'Net_i', 'Net_j', 'Net_k' each have a small red arrow pointing down-right onto the top neuron of cols 2/3/4. Blue italic weight labels sit on the lines: 'w_ji' (between cols 2-3, rows 1 and 2), 'w_kj' (between cols 3-4, row 1), 'w_ki' (row 1 area and a second instance rotated ~90° on the col2→col4 skip line, row 2).

Two magenta callout boxes with thin magenta borders and bold black two-line text: left box 'Input Samples' (with a small left-pointing arrow on its left edge), right box 'Sample Label'. A horizontal magenta dashed line runs from the Input Samples box across almost the full slide width to the Sample Label box.

visual_elements.description: Three light-green (yellow-green) rectangles with black text, vertically stacked and row-aligned: 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m'.

Vertical dark-red bar to the right of the network panel containing the word 'Error' three times in bright red bold text rotated 90° (reading bottom-to-top), one instance aligned with each network row.

Three thick upward-pointing block arrows rising from the bottom callout boxes into the network panel, each with a single white letter inside the shaft: blue arrow 'i' (under col 2), green arrow 'j' (under col 3), orange arrow 'k' (under col 4).

Three two-line callout boxes at bottom: light-blue box 'Previous Layer' / 'Layer (i)'; light-green box 'Current Layer' / '(You are here)'; light-orange box 'Next Layer' / 'Layer (K)'. Black small text, thin matching-color borders.

Slide chrome: thin dark-red rectangular frame border inset around the entire slide (clearly visible along top and left edges) and a solid black horizontal bar across the very bottom edge of the slide.

recreation_brief:
1. Canvas: create a white (#FFFFFF) slide; set the default font to a sans-serif face (Arial/Tahoma-like) for all text.
2. Frame: draw a thin dark-red (#990000) rectangle outline (~2pt line, no fill) inset ~2% from all four slide edges.
3. Bottom bar: draw a solid black (#000000) rectangle spanning the full slide width, ~3% of slide height, flush with the very bottom edge.
4. Title: add a centered text box at top (x 30-70%, y 8-16%) reading 'Neural Network Model' in bold ~36pt red #CC0000, title case.
5. Input Samples box: draw a magenta rectangle (fill #FF99FF, thin #CC66CC border) at x 6-13%, y 22-28%, with bold black ~11pt text 'Input Samples' stacked on two lines ('Input' / 'Samples'); attach a small left-pointing arrow to its left edge (arrow color not specified in source).
6. Sample Label box: draw an identical magenta rectangle at x 86-94%, y 22-28%, with bold black ~11pt two-line text 'Sample' / 'Label'.
7. Header connector: draw a horizontal magenta dashed line at y ≈25% from the right edge of the Input Samples box to the left edge of the Sample Label box.
8. Network panel: draw a rounded rectangle, fill beige #D6C6B6, no border, from x 6-82%, y 29-77%.
9. Neurons: place 15 circles (diameter ≈4% of slide width) in 3 rows x 5 columns inside the panel; column centers x ≈15%, 26%, 44%, 61%, 72%; row centers y ≈37%, 53%, 69%; fills: column 1 #CCCCCC, column 2 #99CCFF, column 3 #99FF66, column 4 #FFCC66, column 5 #CCCCCC.
10. Neuron internals: in each of the 15 circles draw a vertical black divider line and place black ~10pt 'Σ' in the left half and 'S' in the right half.
11. Hollow circles after column 1: place three small hollow circles ('o o o') immediately right of each column-1 neuron (9 circles total).
12. Hollow circles before column 5: place two small hollow circles ('o o') immediately left of each column-5 neuron (6 circles total).
13. Input dots: stack 4 small magenta (#CC00CC) dots vertically at the far-left edge of the panel and draw thin gray lines fanning from these dots into the 3 column-1 neurons.
14. Connections 2→3: draw thin red (#CC0000) lines fully meshing all 3 column-2 neurons to all 3 column-3 neurons (9 lines).
15. Connections 3→4: draw thin red (#CC0000) lines fully meshing all 3 column-3 neurons to all 3 column-4 neurons (9 lines).
16. Skip connections 2→4: draw thin red (#CC0000) lines fully meshing all 3 column-2 neurons to all 3 column-4 neurons (9 lines).
17. Net labels: add red italic 'Net_i', 'Net_j', 'Net_k' above columns 2, 3, 4 respectively, each with a small red arrow pointing down-right onto the top neuron of its column.
18. Activation labels: add red italic 'O_i' at the upper right of each of the 3 blue (column-2) neurons, 'O_j' at each of the 3 green (column-3) neurons, and 'O_k' at each of the 3 orange (column-4) neurons (9 labels).
19. Weight labels: add blue (#0000CC) italic 'w_ji' twice on the column-2→3 lines (rows 1 and 2), 'w_kj' once on the column-3→4 line (row 1), and 'w_ki' once in the row-1 area plus once rotated ~90° on the column-2→4 skip line (row 2) (5 labels total).
20. Output 1: from the row-1 column-5 neuron draw a short black arrow to a black (#000000) rectangle with white ~10pt text 'Output 1', at x ≈74-81%, aligned with row 1.
21. Output 2: same black arrow into a black rectangle with white text 'Output 2', aligned with row 2.
22. Output m: same black arrow into a black rectangle with white text 'Output m', aligned with row 3.
23. Error bar: draw a tall dark-red (#990000) rectangle at x 82-86%, y 30-72%.
24. Error text: inside the bar place 'Error' 3 times in bold red (#FF0000) ~14pt, each rotated 270° (i.e., 90° counterclockwise, reading bottom-to-top), one aligned with each network row.
25. Class 1: draw a light-green (#99FF33) rectangle with black ~11pt text 'Class 1' at x 86-95%, aligned with network row 1.
26. Class 2: same #99FF33 rectangle with black text 'Class 2', aligned with network row 2.
27. Class m: same #99FF33 rectangle with black text 'Class m', aligned with network row 3.
28. Arrow i: draw a thick blue (#3366CC) upward block arrow at x ≈27%, y 72-82%, tip entering the panel under column 2, with white letter 'i' inside the shaft.
29. Arrow j: thick green (#33CC33) upward block arrow at x ≈44%, y 72-82%, tip under column 3, white letter 'j'.
30. Arrow k: thick orange (#FF9933) upward block arrow at x ≈61%, y 72-82%, tip under column 4, white letter 'k'.
31. Callout 'Previous Layer': light-blue (#99CCFF) rectangle with thin blue border at x 22-32%, y 82-88%, two-line black ~10pt text 'Previous Layer' / 'Layer (i)'.
32. Callout 'Current Layer': light-green (#99FF66) rectangle with thin green border at x 39-49%, y 82-88%, two-line black text 'Current Layer' / '(You are here)'.
33. Callout 'Next Layer': light-orange (#FFCC66) rectangle with thin orange border at x 56-66%, y 82-88%, two-line black text 'Next Layer' / 'Layer (K)'.
34. Do NOT draw the small white mouse-cursor arrow near the middle green neuron (row 2) — it is a screen-recording artifact, not slide content.
